text:
incident-bot: Pager duty: P0 - privnet gateway (privnet-gw-3) degraded for customer AureateBank — elevated 5xx from NLB healthchecks, started 2024-04-28 22:13 UTC
ben-net: Seeing NLB target health flapping and route fallback to ALB -> customers hitting 502s. Aureate noticed spikes ~22:10 UTC.
alice.ops: I'm on it. assigning to oncall. @dana-sre are you able to join triage?
dana-sre: joining. pulling metrics and logs now. what pool is this on? hosted/dedicated/private?
carlos-support: This is Private VPC (AureateBank) running privnet-gw-3 in eu-west-1 — dedicated tenant pool, NLB in front of gateway instances. customer reported errors in Prod (session-creating endpoints).
dana-sre: top-line from prometheus: gateway_5xx_rate jumped from 0.5% -> 18% at 22:09. NLB target_healthy_count down from 6 -> 2.
ben-net: quick dump of recent ELB state (sanitized):
```
aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn tg-0a1b2c3d
TargetHealthDescriptions:
 - Id: i-0abcd1234
   State: unhealthy
   Reason: TLS_HANDSHAKE_FAILURE
 - Id: i-0efgh5678
   State: unhealthy
   Reason: timed_out
```

ben-net: NLB healthcheck logs show repeated `connection reset` and `read timeout` from NLB health probe IPs.
alice.ops: Any recent infra changes? security-group rules?
ben-net: There was a terraform apply yesterday 18:45 UTC that adjusted SGs for 'privnet-health' to tighten egress. I suspect health probe source CIDR wasn't allowed.
dana-sre: can someone confirm the SG attached to instances allows the NLB health check source range (we expect 10.0.128.0/22 in this VPC)?
ben-net: checking...
ben-net: yep, SG `sg-priv-gw` shows `allow inbound TCP 8443 from 10.0.0.0/8` but the NLB probes come from the internal ELB range 10.0.128.0/22 which we narrowed out.
carlos-support: Customer says some users see session errors and intermittent 502s. Impact: high for write flows. Aureate has a patch window at 02:00 UTC, they want mitigation now.
dana-sre: mitigation plan — quick options: (1) reopen SG to include 10.0.128.0/22 (fastest), (2) change target group health check port/path to a port allowed (but app might not respond), (3) Route53 weight shift to ALB fallback (risk: session affinity lost). Prefer (1) for minimal risk.
alice.ops: agree. Who can apply SG change? I can if we get approval. Need change ticket and rollback plan.
ben-net: I'll open a temporary SG rule now and verify health. patch: `aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-priv-gw --protocol tcp --port 8443 --cidr 10.0.128.0/22 --description 'temp allow NLB health probes'`
dana-sre: while that's happening, create a target restoration monitor: `watch -n 3 aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn tg-0a1b2c3d`
ben-net: executed. healthchecks flipping..
ben-net: after rule add: `healthy count 6/6` confirmed at 22:21 UTC. metrics show 5xx rate falling.
carlos-support: Notified Aureate support channel: "We deployed a temporary health-probe allow rule; monitoring. Expect degraded errors to clear."
kevin.aureate: Thanks team — seeing traffic recover. Keep us posted on root cause and permanent fix.
dana-sre: root cause hypothesis: Terraform tightened egress/cidrs and inadvertently excluded NLB probe source range. Permanent fix options: add explicit NLB probe CIDRs to infra modules OR use instance-side /health on open port not dependent on external probe IPs.
alice.ops: Add ticket to infra backlog: INFRA-1729 (update privnet SG module to include ELB probe CIDRs + test harness). dan a, can you add postmortem and eval steps?
dana-sre: will draft a short blameless postmortem. include: timeline, ingress/egress SG change, lack of config test for probe coverage, mitigation steps, code snippet to include.
ben-net: adding recovery notes: applied SG change at 1714507280 (22:21 UTC); rolled back to strict rule after verifying internal health probing via agent at 23:05 UTC with an explicit ALB probe-based fallback deployed.
carlos-support: We told Aureate: temporary rule applied, we will coordinate permanent change in next maintenance window. They asked for time estimate — we proposed 48 hours for infra module change + testing.
nana-not-a-real-bot: (automated) Incident timeline updated in JIRA: INC-22456 created and linked. Pager group notified.
alice.ops: handoff — I'll monitor for 1 hour then hand to morning shift. Dana, can you include a small smoke test script so QA can validate?
dana-sre: smoke test:
```
# verify NLB target health
aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn tg-0a1b2c3d | jq '.TargetHealthDescriptions[].TargetHealth.State'
# curl gateway health endpoint from bastion
curl -I https://privnet-gw-3.internal:8443/health
```

dana-sre: also add unit check in terraform plan to ensure `privnet-health-cidrs` contains ELB probe ranges.
ben-net: one more action: we enabled a Route53 weighted failover record to ALB with 10% weight in case of recurrence. configured TTL 30s.
carlos-support: Customer impact cleared per Aureate SRE at 22:35 UTC. They will run regression tests.
kevin.aureate: Confirmed our transactions resumed and no data loss. Thanks for the fast fix.
alice.ops: closing loop: change set created INFRA-1729, postmortem in progress, monitoring set. I'll update oncall channel in 15m. Good job. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Status update posted: P0 -> mitigated. Runbook step executed: SG temporary rule added and later reverted; infra ticket created.
ben-net: moving to monitoring-only. Will follow up on permanent infra PR.
dana-sre: draft postmortem link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-22456 (will populate details).
alice.ops: handoff to morning: @emma-eng please pick up tomorrow 08:00 UTC to finish PR review.
emma-eng: noted, will take it.
ben-net: thanks everyone, closing thread once postmortem merged.
